## [1.1.0](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-27)

### ✨ New Features

* add per-chat disable option and pre-release on dev ([01e99b6](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/01e99b6dc7b3d23fd6cc3b5135acf054eec07c06))
* add Read-only mode restrictions and toggles to hide media heart and share buttons ([9a962e5](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/9a962e5148da44c48586166d73e2a1dd69fbe87c))
* add UI hiding options per-chat highlight toggle and Read-only avatar/name options ([e8786dc](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/e8786dc52cedeb5ea810b8db7061cad62374b354))
* hide right menu button and disable group title tap in Read-only mode ([94fbc29](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/94fbc291be87e93719b01d6acc4a612b1aa2c98b))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* avoid register clobbering in context menu hook ([1445ad9](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/1445ad93e50df84bf0dccd552b8068567da956f2))
* bump dev pre-release ([1171ac9](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/1171ac941df271aab475651fde79d144656f5261))
* capture conversation id at W6 entry before p1 reuse ([c7d1ada](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/c7d1ada6bdcde03bc41615d6cf77bc28b0c74073))
* chat highlight not working and search button unclickable in read-only ([d270507](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/d2705077f45d9f12f77fbb8a28b7ea028739e1f2))
* crash when opening a chat ([0ad413d](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/0ad413d0a3e3405d29bb53f00b039554b8a2a081))
* detect l7j item in proxy args and show locked chat banner ([af6e7e9](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/af6e7e9b9dc49175d2b649797b941366b03dba24))
* hide group info actions and top bar buttons in Read-only mode add Read-only settings toggle ([a7fc80a](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/a7fc80a8cc4d17dc5d207b4c7f4160f95690aade))
* patch compilation error in group info hooks ([7e76156](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/7e76156ee70f7888b357a78cc9bdc88461117094))
* properly hide QR button add button and search bar on Messages tab ([d948926](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/d9489266b092b14fd1ededfe72d877a365616d36))
* proxy original listener interfaces instead of Object field type ([33190f0](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/33190f06d8e3e59aaf597dca06b86e45c10f34da))
* resolve VerifyError in ReactionPickerView constructor hook ([b4a5c6a](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/b4a5c6a9db3c9a943fd711f0f7be1fa348ec889c))
* trigger dev release ([a8f2639](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/a8f26392de2b8d4d81ce4bfb6dfe53044d3ace38))
* use declared reflection and logging in AnhpanChatLock ([81f230d](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/81f230d4a1813dbfec1664516f7c5c7ea470332b))
* use explicit v-registers in chat lock hooks ([93bef99](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/93bef998034055cd4be557a43bf93bd2a6ada6f0))
* use move-object/from16 for high parameter registers ([e2dcfff](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/e2dcfff324036525c3269a48731cf32b977dcb07))
* use untyped getInstruction 0 for unread highlight hook ([72029b1](https://github.com/rustybrozen/anhpan-patches/commit/72029b11e9419dbd39e83d175996496331c989a4))
